items.title: What happens to clarification questions as the spec gets more complete?
items.description: Priya's original handoff specified only 1 of 5 states — about 20% complete. Drag the slider to see how many follow-up questions (or silent guesses) an engineer is left to resolve on their own as spec completeness rises toward covering every state, value, and edge case.
items.compute: const questions = Math.max(1, Math.round(15 * (1 - params.specCompleteness / 100) + 1)); return { questions };

outputs.label: Open questions / guesses left to the engineer

items.title: What happens to rework cost as design QA moves later in the build?
items.description: In the checkout incident, design QA happened 2 days before launch. Drag the slider to see roughly how many hours of rework a gap costs depending on how many days before launch it's caught — the same drift found early is a cheap adjustment; found late, it's a rushed rewrite of already-merged work.

params.name: daysBeforeLaunch
params.label: Days before launch when QA runs

items.compute: const hours = Math.round((2 + 100 * Math.exp(-params.daysBeforeLaunch / 8)) * 10) / 10; return { hours };
